[IDAT.4.1] `ds_fact_t` is the working-memory fact record: DS-level
metadata, a pointer to the paired Rete fact (`rete_fact`,
a `ds_rete_fact_t *`), and the fact's slot values
unpacked into a trailing flexible-array member at
allocation time.

`struct ds_fact` is declared in `runtime/src/libds/wm.h` — internal to the reference runtime, which is what this tree describes ([STYL.2.13.6]).
